title: REST search on sys_user answers 403 for non-admin members (search expands to hidden role / ban_reason / last_login_ip) — every user picker breaks when typing
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect with reach (HTTP + console, measured once).

**Business reason.** Every user / owner picker in an app (e.g. a contract's legal reviewer, a category's category manager) is unusable for non-admin users as soon as they type: the picker shows a red security error instead of matches. Admins don't see it, so it slips past admin-only testing. Found during the hotsrm v0.3 acceptance browser test.

**Who acts.** The seat owning ObjectQL field-level read guards / REST `search` expansion (objectstack). The console only sends `search=`; no objectui change needed unless the fix is to narrow the search columns client-side.

## Repro (18.0.0, `objectstack dev`, sqlite)

1. Sign in as any ordinary member (no admin role), e.g. a user holding only an app position.
2. `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user?search=abc`

Actual: `403`

```
[Security] Access denied: query on 'sys_user' references field(s) not readable by the caller: role, ban_reason, last_login_ip. Filtering, sorting, grouping, or aggregating by a hidden field would leak its values (filter oracle) — remove these predicates or grant field read access.
```

Same call without `search` (`?filter=["banned","!=",true]`) answers 200. The console's user lookup sends `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user?populate=primary_business_unit_id&top=25&search=<typed text>&filter=["banned","!=",true]`, so opening the picker lists users but typing any character shows the error.

Expected: the free-text `search` expansion only covers fields the caller can read (or `sys_user`'s searchable fields exclude `role`, `ban_reason`, `last_login_ip`), so a member gets matches on name / email.

## Dedupe

Searched objectstack-ai issues (open + closed) for "user lookup search sys_user filter oracle ban_reason last_login_ip" and "user field lookup typeahead search non-admin hidden fields": 0 relevant hits.
